name: What is the typical cost range for flooring replacement?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for flooring replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of flooring replacement varies significantly based on material choice, square footage, existing floor removal, and installation complexity. For example, carpet can range from $2 to $8 per square foot installed, while luxury vinyl typically falls between $3 and $10 per square foot. Hardwood flooring can range from $6 to $15+ per square foot installed, and tile can be anywhere from $5 to $20+ per square foot, depending on the tile type and installation. These estimates usually include labor but can fluctuate. Obtaining a detailed quote tailored to your specific project is always recommended.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary widely based on material, square footage, and labor. Carpet and luxury vinyl are generally more affordable, while hardwood and tile can be higher. Get a detailed quote for accurate pricing.
